solution: Solution: Use the identity $\cos A - \cos B = -2\sin\left(\frac{A+B}{2}\right)\sin\left(\frac{A-B}{2}\right)$ . Denominator: $\cos 4x - \cos 5x = -2\sin\left(\frac{9x}{2}\right)\sin\left(-\frac{x}{2}\right)=2\sin\left(\frac{9x}{2}\right)\sin\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)$ . Equivalent resonance structures give greater stabilization to the carboxylate ion than the non-equivalent resonance structures give to the phenoxide ion. A more stable conjugate base corresponds to a stronger acid. Thus $(A)$ is correct, $(R)$ is correct, and $(R)$ is the correct explanation of $(A)$ .
